old_problem: Ethernet title/IP ping were treated as equal to an IB branch solely because ibstat was named; active five-cycle coverage was absent.
disposition_reason: The protected title and IP-ping steps establish Ethernet mode. Under ED-05, IB is a separate branch and is not silently introduced here; ibstat is retained only as optional Mellanox/VPI correlation when the pinned driver exposes the Ethernet port, while ip/ethtool carrier is authoritative. Port mappings and timeouts are runtime bindings.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row63 all18 XLSX cells and history2674.
Preserved exactly five down/up and peer-ping recovery cycles per Mellanox Ethernet port.
Rejected DeepSeek's read-only report and any substitution of an IB test; no link changed.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized Mellanox Ethernet five-cycle link and IP recovery validation
test_case.purpose: Verify each approved Mellanox Ethernet port transitions down/up, loses/regains peer IP connectivity and remains healthy after exactly five cycles.
required_package: Dedicated non-management peer/IP and independent OOB recovery
Pinned driver/firmware/iproute2/ethtool; optional ibstat correlation policy
Down/up dwell and carrier/address/ping recovery timeouts
Bond/bridge/VLAN/SR-IOV/storage exclusions, abort and final-state rollback
test_case.test_command: Validate Ethernet mode and signed port mapping; record link/address/route/counters/log baseline. For each authorized netdev, run exactly five administrative down/up cycles, proving carrier and ping loss while down and bounded carrier/address/peer-ping recovery while up. Use ip/ethtool as authoritative Ethernet state; record ibstat only if the pinned Mellanox stack exposes a same-port correlation. Restore baseline state.
test_case.expected_result: Each target shows down/no peer traffic then up/recovered peer traffic in all five cycles, returns to expected speed/duplex/state and has no driver, counter or platform error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires Ethernet identity, five complete per-port cycles and per-cycle traffic recovery. Read-only output or an IB-only state cannot pass this Ethernet case.
safety_gate: Never infer netdev/BDF mapping or flap management/storage paths.
Require independent OOB and approved service window.
Do not claim IB coverage or use ibstat as sole Ethernet proof.
Abort on recovery timeout, routing drift, counter/driver error or OOB impact; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Five timestamped down/up carrier and peer-ping records per port
Optional same-port ibstat correlation with link-layer evidence
Complete logs, abort status and restoration
test_case.recovery: If a port fails to recover, stop remaining cycles, use independent OOB to restore its recorded administrative/address state, preserve ethtool/ip/route/counter/driver evidence, and require Mellanox/network owner review before further flap.
